cards.text: Ezra the priest is facedown before the house of God, praying to his God. Israelites, even priests and Levites, have married women from the peoples around them, and Ezra is weeping as he confesses that unfaithfulness (Ezra 9:1-2). And while he's down there, he's not alone for long.

cards.question: While Ezra prays facedown before the house of God, who gathers around him?

answers.text: A very large assembly of Israelites

cards.question: As Ezra weeps, the crowd around him weeps bitterly too.

cards.text: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, an Elamite, speaks up to Ezra: we have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the people of the land. Notice he says WE, friend.

cards.question: Shecaniah admits Israel has been unfaithful, yet he says there is still ___ for Israel.

cards.text: And Shecaniah's got a plan. He wants it done according to the Law, following the counsel of those who tremble at the command of God.

cards.question: What covenant does Shecaniah want the people to make before God?

answers.text: Send away the foreign wives and their children
Rebuild the walls all around Jerusalem
Keep a fast for forty days and nights

cards.text: Then Shecaniah tells Ezra, "Get up, for this matter is your responsibility…" And he doesn't stop there.

cards.question: When Shecaniah tells Ezra to get up and take action, what does he promise him?

answers.text: The people will pick a new leader
The people will return to Babylon

cards.text: So Ezra gets up. When somebody says 'this one's yours, and we're right behind you,' friend, that is NOT a snooze-button moment.

cards.question: Ezra makes the leading priests, Levites and all Israel ___ to do what Shecaniah said.

cards.text: Then Ezra leaves the front of the house of God and walks to the chamber of a man named Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He's mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.

cards.question: While Ezra stays in Jehohanan's chamber, he eats and drinks with the leaders.

cards.text: Then a proclamation goes out across Judah and Jerusalem. Every exile, gather at Jerusalem.

cards.question: The exiles get ___ days to show up in Jerusalem.
What happens to any exile who doesn't show up in Jerusalem in time?

answers.text: He loses his property and is expelled from the assembly
He pays a fine in silver to the house of God
He is sent back to Babylon to live for good

cards.text: And within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin show up in Jerusalem. Not 'whenever I get a chance,' not 'let's circle back next week,' friend, THREE DAYS.

cards.question: On the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone sits in the square at the house of God, trembling over this matter. What else has them trembling?

cards.text: Then Ezra the priest stands up in front of all of them and says, "You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women, adding to the guilt of Israel."

cards.question: Ezra tells them to make a confession to the LORD, do His will, and ___ themselves from the people of the land and from their foreign wives.

cards.text: The whole assembly answers in a loud voice: "Truly we must do as you say!" Then comes that little pause, the same one after 'Sure, I'll help you move,' and you just KNOW a BUT is coming.

cards.question: The assembly agrees with Ezra, sitting out in that square. What do they say makes it hard to settle everything right there?

answers.text: Many people and the rainy season
Too few priests to help out

cards.question: With so many people and the rain coming down, how does the assembly suggest dealing with the men who married foreign women?

answers.text: Leaders represent everyone while towns come at set times
Each family handles its own case quietly at home
Everyone gathers again once the rainy season ends

cards.question: In the assembly's plan, each town's men who married foreign women come at an appointed time with the elders and ___ of their town.
The assembly says this plan should keep going until something is turned away from them. What is it?

answers.text: The fierce anger of their God
The armies of the nearby peoples
The heavy rain of the season

cards.text: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah oppose the plan, with Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite backing them. That WHOLE crowd, and the opposition fits in one carpool.
So the exiles go with the plan, and Ezra the priest picks the men to lead it. Every one of them identified by NAME, friend, not 'hey, you, by the door.'

cards.question: Ezra picks men, each one identified by name, to speak for the people. What kind of men are they?

cards.text: On the first day of the tenth month, they launch the investigation. That's a big job, friend, so CLEAR the calendar.

cards.question: By the first day of the first month, they've dealt with only half of the men who married foreign women.

cards.text: Then comes a long list, family by family, of the men who had married foreign women. It starts with priests from the family of Jeshua son of Jozadak, who pledged to send their wives away and gave a ram as a guilt offering. Then come Levites, a singer, gatekeepers and men from across Israel. Some of them had children by these wives, and I think that's a heavy line to end on.
